title: Saved-card checkout
outcome: Returning customers can pay with a saved payment method without re-entering card details.
requirements: Payment credentials remain with the payment provider.
Only the account owner can use a saved payment method.
An unavailable saved method does not prevent ordinary checkout.

parts.title: Payment preferences
parts.overview: Keeps account-owned references to provider-managed payment methods.

relationships.description: Loads the account owner’s saved payment-method reference
Requests payment using the selected saved reference
